idea.name: Estate sale and liquidation company
idea.one_liner: Arrange and run in-home or warehouse sales for households that need to clear an estate; earn a share of sales and sometimes charge a minimum fee.
idea.customer: Households and heirs dealing with a death, divorce, debt, or downsizing.
idea.offer: Price, market, staff, and run the sale of household contents, with leftover items moved to a warehouse or auction when needed.
idea.revenue_model: Commission on items sold, sometimes with a minimum guarantee; can also earn from warehouse sales and related services.
